2023.name: Web Developer
2023.desc: Developed an electrical schematic builder from scratch, improving calculation time by 40% using advanced algorithms and deployed in 4 subsidiaries. Built a high-performance UI with React, Redux-Saga, and integrated CI/CD pipelines via Azure DevOps. Optimized system scalability using Redis caching for high load.

2022.name: Web Developer
2022.desc: Created a data analysis service using React.js and JavaScript, enhancing insights into user engagement. Refactored the old UI codebase, improving performance and scalability. Fixed legacy issues and optimized a user authorization system to improve user experience.

2022.name: Web Developer
2022.desc: Developed UI for carbon emission reduction simulations (TS, React JS, Redux, etc.). Migrated an old real-time messaging system from jQuery to a RabbitMQ-based architecture, reducing API response latency.

2021.name: Mobile Developer (iOS, Android, web)
2021.desc: Developed multi-platform user interface applications (iOS, Android, Web) with React Native, serving over 10,000 users. Built scalable front-end solutions for B2C applications such as Omedom (multiple property management) and Scanflock (telemedicine platform). Integrated real-time video calls and document generation to enhance user interactivity.
